annotations.title: Book a senior into a slot

description: Book one senior into one slot of a session. Only with the senior's agreement. The reply is the confirmation (booked: true, with the venue, address, date and time to tell the person). Bookings cannot be changed or cancelled here; to change or cancel, call Youngster on 1300 774 711.

booker_name.description: Optional. Name of the person arranging this, if not the senior. Letters, spaces, hyphens and apostrophes only.

booker_relationship.description: Optional. How the booker knows the senior, e.g. "daughter", "carer", "self".

senior_agreed.description: Must be true: only book a senior who asked for or agreed to this booking.

senior_first_name.description: First name of the senior who will attend. Letters, spaces, hyphens and apostrophes only.

senior_last_name.description: Last name of the senior who will attend. Letters, spaces, hyphens and apostrophes only.

senior_phone.description: The senior's Australian phone number, e.g. "0412 345 678". A mobile gets reminder texts.

slot_id.description: A slot_id from that same session in list_sessions.

name: book_slot
